html: יען (√ foll.; according to Ges EwGGA 1864, No. 27 Aramaic ܝܺܥܶܢ, ܝܰܥܢܳܐ avidus, cupidus; hence בַּת יַעֲנָה = daughter of greed, of ostrich as voracious bird; but WetzstDel Jb 31:39 = daughter of the desert or steppe, from وَعْنَةٌ hard, unproductive soil; cf. the Arabic name أَبُو ٱلصَّحَارَى father of the plains.)
